policy: Use exactly the existing 48 validated PN ports and all same-face independently admitted pairs. Do not add invented targets or change the earlier fixed-input admission predicate.
test: Enumerate target-record fibers over source alone, source plus target roles, source plus target named references, and source plus requested target chart. Distinct full records in one fiber obstruct that exact factorization. Also enumerate refusals for all requested charts.
boundary: Extensional finite target selection from a supplied admitted table is not a source-generated native role-changing operation. Ambiguity after forgetting the requested chart is not failure of a chart-parameterized map.
stop_condition: Return exact fiber cardinalities, retained record witnesses and defined/refused requested-chart counts.
